issue.title: [ test_reboot ] has been skipped for almost all platforms and vendors

failure.body:
**Description**
After PR https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/pull/4624 platform_test/test_reboot has been skipped for almost all platforms except a few that has "port_type" provided in hwsku.json  [port_type](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/search?p=1&q=%27port_type%27)

**This fix has few negative impacts for community:**

1. Skip cases for most supported platforms.
2. Skip added inside function that check interfaces and services that happens after reboot - so basically TC performs set up procedure, than reboot DUT and only after skipped.
3. Even when "port_type" will be provided check expects at least 1 port has port_type="RJ45", if platform does not have it - test case will be skipped also.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Run TC from platform_tests/test_reboot.py

**Describe the results you received:**
TC skipped with error: "XFailed: hwsku.json is needed for interface checking to pass, and it is not provided."

**Describe the results you expected:**
TC passed or failed

**Additional information you deem important:**

**show version output:**

Distribution: Debian 11.2
Kernel: 5.10.0-8-2-amd64

Platform: x86_64-accton_as9516_32d-r0
HwSKU: newport
ASIC: barefoot

resolution.title: [reboot] Remove restriction on test_reboot.py
resolution.description:
Missing hwsku.json might cause test_reboot.py to fail on some platforms
but not others. In previous commits, hwsku.json will be checked and if
missing, xfail the test. In this commit, the check is removed and some
machine where it is known will have the test skipped. In future commits,
this check will be implemented again but further limited to a few hwsku.

Signed-off-by: Xichen Lin <<EMAIL>>

### Description of PR

Missing hwsku.json might cause test_reboot.py to fail on some platforms
but not others. In previous commits, hwsku.json will be checked and if
missing, xfail the test. In this commit, the check is removed and some
machine where it is known will have the test skipped. In future commits,
this check will be implemented again but further limited to a few hwsku.
